name: 松紧腰透气薄款男童牛仔哈伦裤款
description: 轻薄透气亲肤牛仔质感，松紧腰穿脱方便，哈伦版型舒适不拘束

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, warm off-white #F7F6F2 info panels, deep denim indigo #2B3F63 accent panels, soft outdoor daylight for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with front-left key, soft contact shadows, gentle and airy mood, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey fabric-friendly board #E9E7E2 and clean flat surfaces, natural wood or playground ground for scenes
styleLock.typography: rounded modern sans-serif, clean and child-friendly
styleLock.iconSystem: simple flat star and dot accents in #FFD400, sparse and playful, never covering the product
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on eye-level and slight 3/4 hero angles, pants always shown uncuffed-to-cuffed hem clearly, stable scale across the set
noDrift: no adult model or recognizable child face
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful clean kids fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of denim indigo #2B3F63, warm off-white #F7F6F2, sunny yellow accent #FFD400 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; sparse playful flat accent shapes in #FFD400; clean childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no recognizable child face.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底童裤主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, pants presented flat and centered, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pants laid flat and centered, straight-on eye-level front view, full silhouette visible with elastic waistband and rolled cuffs clearly shown. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace reserved. 8K, commercial childrenswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no hanger, no child model, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：p1 主图哈伦裤+『95%棉 会呼吸的棉』文案与棉田铺垫；p2 棉田背景卖点图（透气/挺括/柔顺/不起球标签）+尺码表（列含裤长/腰围/臀围/档深/建议身高，建议身高段约100）；p3 吸水滴测试示意+亲肤吸汗文案；p4 腰头微距+哈伦版型后视图；p5 松紧腰细节特写；p6 裤脚收口与织标/皮标特写（含英文字样装饰）；p7 走线做工特写。品类判定：尺码表按建议身高分段、松紧腰童裤外穿牛仔形态、『萌宝/宝宝穿着』文案 → 母婴/童装（外穿），非内衣家居服/儿童内衣；源夹名童装一致，无需改判。已剥离：原品牌织标与皮标字样、原文案原句（棉含量百分比改为占位不写入）、卡通鱼骨星星贴片美术、日文小字段落；产品一律以 {product} 占位，童模仅允许颈部以下背影出现，禁第三方卡通形象与商标图形。
